promise: End inflation within the first year of his second term
description: In an August 2024 economic address Trump pledged to use 'every tool' to defeat inflation within the first year of a second term. US CPI inflation remained positive at roughly 2.5-3% through 2025, and prices never fell.
evidence: Trump later said lowering prices was 'hard' and 'can't guarantee anything'

review.note: Senate report cites August 14 speech but first-year deadline unestablished. Ending inflation does not require prices to fall; current evidence conflates disinflation and deflation. Need speech and BLS series.

promise: Energy prices will come down 50% or more within a year
description: Trump's campaign pledge was to cut energy costs by half in his first year. PolitiFact found gasoline declined from $3.11 at inauguration to $2.78 in the second week of January 2026, while electricity and natural-gas prices rose.
evidence: January 2026 prices did not demonstrate a 50% reduction in energy costs.

review.note: PolitiFact supports missed first-year target but gives $2.78 gasoline in January 2026, contradicting claim it stayed $3.10-3.30. January 20 pledge date not established; promise originated during campaign.

role: United Nations member states ratifying the BBNJ Agreement
promise: Bring the BBNJ Agreement into force 120 days after the sixtieth ratification
description: The agreement was adopted June 19, 2023. The sixtieth ratification on September 19, 2025 triggered entry into force on January 17, 2026.
evidence: The UN records entry into force on January 17, 2026.

promise: Initiate talks on a new Constitution in January 2026
description: Dissanayake told the Ilankai Tamil Arasu Kadchi that his government would begin talks on a promised new Constitution in January 2026. A multisectoral dialogue on the new constitution was held in January 2026, and the government continued to accelerate the reform process, though the constitution had not been finalised by mid-2026.
evidence: Multisectoral dialogue on a new constitution held January 2026
Constitutional reform process ongoing as of July 2026

review.note: November meeting is supported. Searches for January 2026 implementation found civic constitutional discussion but did not establish the claimed government-led multisectoral dialogue or whether it fulfilled the promised talks. Drafting a constitution is a different outcome from initiating talks; lack of a finalized constitution cannot justify partial status for this narrower promise.
